question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at line PQ as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e064924c54067d8ecc0f85d0e6da6cebf2316f57c2dc6394e1d660795b90c45.png]
solution:
The mirror image of the given figure is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0da0506c07bc3f390cdfb8c37120a817e76ece952de138a05c78b4f49b3eb719.png] 

 
• The line PQ is mirror.
 
• The shaded second box from left of below five boxes will become shaded for second box from right side in mirror image → Option 1 is eliminated.
 
• The right top corner some part is shaded will be shifted to left top corner part in mirror image → Option 3 is eliminated.
 
• The arrow which is pointed down wards of 1st box from left of below five boxes will point 1st box from right of below five boxes → Option 4 is eliminated.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
